places.name: Hagia Sophia
places.ai_summary: A historic architectural marvel, the Hagia Sophia has served as a cathedral, mosque, and now a museum, showcasing Byzantine and Ottoman influences.

opening_hours.notes: Closed during prayer times on Fridays.

places.place_tip: Visit early morning to avoid crowds.
places.address: Sultan Ahmet, Ayasofya Meydanı, Fatih, Istanbul, Turkey

attribution.title: Hagia Sophia
attribution.author: Adli Wahid

places.name: Blue Mosque (Sultan Ahmed Mosque)
places.ai_summary: An iconic mosque known for its stunning blue tiles, the Sultan Ahmed Mosque is a masterpiece of Ottoman architecture.
places.place_tip: Wear modest clothing to enter the mosque.
places.address: Sultan Ahmet, Atmeydanı Cd. No:7, Fatih, Istanbul, Turkey

places.name: Topkapi Palace Museum
places.ai_summary: Once the residence of Ottoman sultans, the Topkapi Palace is now a museum showcasing imperial collections and stunning architecture.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Harem section for an additional fee.
places.address: Cankurtaran, Topkapı Sarayı, Fatih, Istanbul, Turkey

places.name: Grand Bazaar
places.ai_summary: One of the largest and oldest covered markets in the world, the Grand Bazaar is a vibrant maze of shops and stalls selling everything from carpets to jewelry.
places.place_tip: Bargain for the best prices.
places.address: Beyazıt, Kalpakçılar Cd. No:22, Fatih, Istanbul, Turkey

places.name: Basilica Cistern
places.ai_summary: An ancient underground water reservoir, the Basilica Cistern is known for its stunning columns and eerie atmosphere.
places.place_tip: Look for the Medusa heads.
places.address: Alemdar, Yerebatan Cd. 1/3, Fatih, Istanbul, Turkey

attribution.title: Cisterna Basílica, Estambul, Turquía, 2024-09-28, DD 58-60 HDR
attribution.author: Diego Delso
attribution.description: View of the Basilica Cistern, Istanbul, Turkey. The Basilica Cistern, or Cisterna Basilica is the largest of several hundred ancient cisterns that lie beneath the city. This subterranean cistern was called Basilica because it was located under a large public square, the Stoa Basilica, on the First Hill of Constantinople. The cistern, built in the 6th century during the reign of Byzantine emperor Justinian I, provided a water filtration system for the Great Palace of Constantinople and other buildings on the First Hill, and continued to provide water to the Topkapı Palace after the Ottoman conquest in 1453 and into modern times. Today it is kept with little water, for public access inside the space.

places.name: Spice Bazaar (Egyptian Bazaar)
places.ai_summary: A colorful and aromatic market, the Spice Bazaar is the perfect place to buy Turkish delights, spices, and souvenirs.
places.place_tip: Try the Turkish delights.
places.address: Rüstem Paşa, Erzak Ambarı Sk. No:92, Fatih, Istanbul, Turkey

places.name: Galata Tower
places.ai_summary: A medieval stone tower, the Galata Tower offers a panoramic view of Istanbul and the Golden Horn.

opening_hours.notes: Last entrance one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Book tickets online to skip the line.
places.address: Karaköy, Galata Kulesi, 34421 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Turkey

places.name: Dolmabahçe Palace
places.ai_summary: A magnificent palace that served as the main administrative center of the Ottoman Empire in the 19th century, showcasing European-style architecture.
places.place_tip: Visit the harem section for an additional fee.
places.address: Vişnezade, Dolmabahçe Cd. No:1, Beşiktaş, Istanbul, Turkey

places.name: Süleymaniye Mosque
places.ai_summary: An Ottoman imperial mosque located on the Third Hill of Istanbul, it is the largest mosque in the city and a stunning example of Islamic architecture.
places.place_tip: Respect the dress code: women should cover their hair, and both men and women should wear modest clothing.
places.address: Süleymaniye, 34116 Fatih/İstanbul, Turkey

places.name: Chora Church (Kariye Museum)
places.ai_summary: A medieval Greek Orthodox church, now a museum, known for its stunning mosaics and frescoes.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the stunning mosaics in the apse.
places.address: Kariye Camii, Derviş Ali Efendi Sk. No: 1, Edirnekapı, Fatih, Istanbul, Turkey

places.name: Istiklal Street
places.ai_summary: A famous pedestrian street in the heart of Istanbul, Istiklal Street is lined with shops, cafes, and restaurants, and is known for its vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Some shops may be closed on Sundays.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food.
places.address: Beyoğlu, Istiklal Cd. No: 1, 34430 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Turkey

places.name: Taksim Square
places.ai_summary: A major public space in Istanbul, Taksim Square is known for its Republic Monument, and as a transportation hub and cultural center.
places.place_tip: Visit the Atatürk Cultural Center.
places.address: Taksim, 34437 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Turkey

places.name: Bosphorus Cruise
places.ai_summary: A cruise on the Bosphorus Strait offers a unique perspective of Istanbul, with views of palaces, bridges, and the city's skyline.

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for departure times.

places.place_tip: Book in advance for the best spots.
places.address: Kabataş, 34437 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Turkey

places.name: Archaeological Museums
places.ai_summary: Istanbul Archaeological Museums is a group of three archaeological museums located in Istanbul, Turkey. The museums contain artifacts from the ancient civilizations of the Aegean, Cyprus, and Anatolia.
places.place_tip: Visit the Ancient Orient Museum section.
places.address: Cankurtaran, 34122 Fatih/İstanbul, Turkey

attribution.title: Istanbularcheology
attribution.author: Metuboy

places.name: Princes' Islands
places.ai_summary: A group of nine islands in the Sea of Marmara, known for their beautiful beaches, historic mansions, and as a peaceful retreat from the city.

opening_hours.notes: Ferries operate between 6:00 AM and 8:00 PM.

places.place_tip: Rent a bike to explore the islands.
places.address: Büyükada, Adalar/İstanbul, Turkey

attribution.title: BuyukadaMainSquare
attribution.author: Metuboy
attribution.description: Statue of Mustafa Kemal Atatürk with the inscription "Yurtta Sulh Cihanda Sulh" in Büyükada, the largest of the Prince Islands in the Sea of Marmara, to the southeast of Istanbul, Turkey.

places.name: Miniaturk
places.ai_summary: A miniature park situated in Istanbul, Turkey. It is one of the largest miniature parks in the world, featuring models of famous Turkish landmarks.
places.place_tip: Visit the café for a great view of the park.
places.address: Sütlüce, 34445 Beyoğlu/İstanbul, Turkey

places.name: Rumeli Fortress
places.ai_summary: A fortress built by the Ottoman Sultan Mehmed II in 1452, located on the European side of the Bosphorus Strait, offering stunning views and historical insights.
places.place_tip: Explore the towers and enjoy the view.
places.address: Rumeli Hisarı, 34470 Sarıyer/İstanbul, Turkey

places.name: Maiden's Tower
places.ai_summary: A tower located on a small islet at the southern entrance of the Bosphorus strait, it has served various purposes throughout history and offers a panoramic view of Istanbul.
places.place_tip: Enjoy a drink at the café with a view.
places.address: Salhane, 34668 Üsküdar/İstanbul, Turkey

places.name: Ortaköy Mosque
places.ai_summary: A beautiful mosque located by the Bosphorus, known for its stunning architecture and picturesque setting.
places.place_tip: Try the kumpir (stuffed baked potato) from a nearby vendor.
places.address: Ortaköy, Mecidiye Sk. No: 1, Beşiktaş, Istanbul, Turkey

places.name: Balat Neighborhood
places.ai_summary: A historic neighborhood in Istanbul, known for its colorful houses, old churches, and synagogues, reflecting the city's diverse cultural heritage.
places.place_tip: Visit the Ahrida Synagogue and the Bulgarian St. Stephen Church.
places.address: Balat, 34087 Fatih/İstanbul, Turkey
